name: cw_burn_then_pump
note: Rung-2 combat window, BOTH seats act in player order: P0's Shock answers the block (non-lethal - the 3/3 Guard survives with 2 marked), then P1's Titanic Growth (in the SAME window, on the POST-BURN state - the Guard is still a legal target) raises it to 6/6. The damage step reads the ledger: the pumped Guard out-fights the 3/3 Brute (dies), taking only 3 of its 6 marked. Pins that the second seat's vocabulary is computed AFTER the first seat's cast has settled. Re-pinned 2026-10-29 (V2): mana empties as each step and phase ends (CR 500.5), so the setup mana (formerly banked across two turns) is added as the combat window opens ('window_mana'), standing in for the lands tapped there (CR 605.3a).
